learner_operation: Use the supplied angle decomposition, choose the correct tangent identity, substitute signed special-angle values, and rationalize to select the exact result.

fixed_features.feature: Five-option exact-value radio response and supplied angle decomposition.
fixed_features.justification: Both standalone examples provide this contract; the target skill is evaluation, not discovering a decomposition.

fixed_features.feature: Special-angle operands, nonstandard first-revolution targets, and fraction-free radical answers.
fixed_features.justification: The canonical/tutorial methods and signed unit-circle prerequisites support these operations. They give four unique exact outcome values, a finite family whose limits are retained.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Four exact values determined by the angle; both signs and magnitude intervals.
answer_roles.observed: Every class appears in requested five and fresh eight; catalog covers each of eight angles 16 times.

answer_roles.role: Which choice positions and bank members are keyed.
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Shuffle positions and construct symmetric two-possible-key banks with wrong competitors.
answer_roles.observed: All positions occur in each visible unit/operation subgroup; identical-bank counterfactual changes the keyed member.

coverage.result: 128 supported decompositions; four unit/operation subgroups of 32; requested five include all four exact results.

coverage.case: Original standalone profiles and canonical example
coverage.result: Complete source banks preserved only in replay profiles; CLI practice uses repaired extension bank. Canonical difference method reproduced.

counterfactuals.change: Keep all five exact option values and input order fixed; change 15 degrees to 105 degrees and its supplied decomposition.
counterfactuals.expected: Correct choice changes from 2-sqrt(3) to -2-sqrt(3), with matching new worked derivation.
counterfactuals.observed: Both choice sets are identical; exact math, native grader and actual UI accept the changed target/key relationship.
counterfactuals.justification: Changing target evidence must change the tangent; same bank prevents bank-only determination.

counterfactuals.change: Rewrite the same target and supplied decomposition in radians rather than degrees while preserving bank values.
counterfactuals.expected: Exact result remains 2-sqrt(3), and shown unit conversions do not change the tangent.
counterfactuals.observed: Exact math and native grader agree; actual UI pi/12=5pi/6-3pi/4 displays the same keyed value and worked steps.
counterfactuals.justification: Angle units are representational, not a different geometric angle. Both units are supported by source examples.

shortcut_probes.strategy: Inspect option text only, without target/key/catalog. Select only if exactly one option has this literal form; otherwise abstain.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: Zero uniquely selected answers; every repaired bank contains two equally shaped possible exact keys. Baseline 0.2 is an uninformed five-choice guess; abstention is not scored as a wrong guess.

shortcut_probes.strategy: Use only target quadrant and its location relative to 45 degrees modulo 180; compare all option numeric intervals. Select only a sole interval match.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: Zero uniquely selected keys; each target interval contains a plausible wrong competitor. Baseline is random selection among five choices.

shortcut_probes.strategy: Use the same coarse target bounds and discard displayed fractions, without assuming exact-family constants.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: Zero singleton successes. At least two fraction-free choices remain in the right interval.

shortcut_probes.cue: Exact answer family combined with bounds
shortcut_probes.strategy: Assume the correct value is one of ±2±sqrt(3), then identify its unique sign/magnitude interval.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: This succeeds but imports the complete exact outcome family. It also succeeds on both original banks. Four distinct values occupy four different intervals, so a unique-key radio bank cannot defeat this conjunction without changing the task. Baseline 0.2 is a five-option guess; this outcome is retained as a finite-family learning limitation, not claimed repaired.

delivery.result: Requested 5/5 and fresh 8/8 survive against basis 6415 with identical per-record decision probes; weighted selection is uniform within available moderate identities and does not inspect key shape.

limitations: The four exact values can be memorized; a learner who knows them plus coarse bounds can answer without recomputing the formula. The combined probe still succeeds and is not hidden.
A finite sample cannot rule out every possible learned shortcut.
Live history can remove identities and change available outcome frequencies; this review binds the captured input pool, not future task draws.
Standalone source worked solutions and key links are absent in capture; exact keys and method are reconstructed from canonical/tutorial evidence.
